title: On Sweeping the whole hall before dawn
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：sweep　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sweep 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the engineer ① swept the whole hall before dawn without a word of thanks, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② sweeps the whole hall before dawn at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sweep the whole hall before dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ swept the whole hall before dawn before — a line in the manual for April 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sweeping the whole hall before dawn without a word of thanks, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sweep down the valley in one night at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sweep down the valley in one night at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ sweeps down the valley in one night without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ swept the whole hall before dawn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sweep the whole hall before dawn, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody sweeps the whole hall before dawn at once again and somebody must sweep the whole hall before dawn without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打扫（一般过去式 swept the whole hall before dawn：1950 年工程师头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 打扫（一般现在 sweeps the whole hall before dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打扫（不定式 to sweep the whole hall before dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打扫（过去完成时 had swept the whole hall before dawn：1944 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打扫（动名词 sweeping the whole hall before dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 席卷（sweep down the valley in one night：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去席卷一夜之间卷过整条山谷）
G. v. 席卷（sweep down the valley in one night：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打扫（后段两处：新来的工人照例 sweeps down the valley in one night，而母亲又一次 swept the whole hall before dawn）

answers.why: sweep 意为“打扫”，1950 年工程师不图一句谢打扫天不亮就把整个大厅扫净，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 swept。
sweep 意为“打扫”，自那以后工程师二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sweeps。
sweep 意为“打扫”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打扫天不亮就把整个大厅扫净”，此处为不定式 to sweep the whole hall before dawn。
sweep 意为“打扫”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人打扫过，故用过去完成时 had swept。
sweep 意为“打扫”，工程师说“打扫天不亮就把整个大厅扫净这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sweeping the whole hall before dawn 作主语。
sweep 意为“席卷”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去席卷一夜之间卷过整条山谷”，should ever 之后用原形 sweep down the valley in one night。
sweep 意为“席卷”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻席卷一夜之间卷过整条山谷（sweep down the valley in one night at once），以后再也不要提起。
sweep 意为“打扫”，新来的工人每个年头都照例席卷一夜之间卷过整条山谷，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sweeps。
sweep 意为“打扫”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢打扫天不亮就把整个大厅扫净，用一般过去式 swept 叙述。
sweep 意为“打扫”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要打扫天不亮就把整个大厅扫净，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sweep 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the engineer swept the whole hall before dawn without a word of thanks, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer sweeps the whole hall before dawn at once whenever the workshop asks.
Sweeping the whole hall before dawn without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sweep down the valley in one night at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop sweeps down the valley in one night without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother swept the whole hall before dawn again, and the workshop remembered that half.
